subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: What cross-session run-progress API should OpenClaw support for long-running `sessions_send` runs, and what authorization, redaction, buffering, replay, and channel-delivery rules should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API shape would expose intermediate run state across sessions, so automation should not choose the contract or security boundary alone.

options.title: Design sessions_subscribe
options.body: Define a separate read-only tool plus gateway event-read method with bounded replay and explicit session/a2a authorization.

options.title: Extend sessions_send
options.body: Add an explicit progress mode to `sessions_send`, preserving current default semantics while forwarding progress only when opted in.

options.title: Defer to process events
options.body: Keep this item pending until the broader structured process-event contract decides replay, identity, and redaction semantics.

recommendation.title: Design sessions_subscribe
recommendation.body: Define a separate read-only tool plus gateway event-read method with bounded replay and explicit session/a2a authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame places the relevant session/gateway event surface on steipete's recent consolidation commit, and this is primarily a core API/security-boundary decision.
